# QAZNEDR HOLDING

> We present areas selected by our geologists based on their review of geological materials. Our team includes Kazakhstani specialists, including geologists with 50 years of experience. We discuss a specific area and the form of cooperation, and support licensing, due diligence, and fieldwork.

## What we offer
- Prepared exploration areas shown as closed teasers: metal, region, deposit type, grade range. Exact coordinates and full data are shared after a meeting and an NDA.
- Deal formats: licence obtained directly for the investor, licence on the holding with a later transfer, joint venture or earn-in, analytics on an area.
- Licensing support for solid-mineral exploration licences in Kazakhstan.
- Field geology by staff geologists; due diligence of areas.

## Important facts
- Prepared areas are free per our check on the date shown on the card; the holding does not claim ownership of them.
- "Free" means free per our check against the public subsoil cadastre map on the stated date; an official extract is obtained before any deal.
- Reserves are Soviet-era categories (A/B/C1/C2); P1–P3 are forecast resources, not reserves. No object has a JORC report yet.
- A transfer of subsoil use rights in Kazakhstan, or of shares in a subsoil user, requires permission of the competent authority (Subsoil Code, articles 44–45), with exceptions listed in article 44(2), such as acquiring less than 25% of a subsoil user company.
- Grade figures are labelled as average, spike or schlich values.
